newsitem.title: USA: Copperweld Corp expands Ohio tubemaking plant.
newsitem.headline: Copperweld Corp expands Ohio tubemaking plant.

text.p: Copperweld Corp said it will spend $49.6 million on expanding its DOM (drawn-over-mandrel) tubemaking plant in Shelby, Ohio.
The project, due on stream at the start of 1999, will increase the plant's capacity for this product by 40,000 tons annually.

"The project will increase the Shelby plant's cold drawing and finishing capacity and allow us to meet the continuing growth in market demand for our DOM products," said John Turner, Copperweld President and CEO.
"It will also help us to further strengthen our existing leadership position in the markets for mechanical steel tubing," Turner added.
The expansion will raise Copperweld's total investment in new production facilities at its U.S. tubing plants to approximately $165 million since 1989.
